# File upload field

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

File inputs only come from the kit dropzone component inside a form page.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=form <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui FileInput, @kit/ui BulkDrop.
- `FileInput` from `@kit/ui` for the file field: The only file input (props: v-model, accept, multiple).
- `BulkDrop` from `@kit/ui` for the drop zone: Drag-and-drop or paste of many files (props: @files).
Checks: ui dropzone. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Not sure this is the right leaf? It answers "Which kind of control?" Call bakery.find, or run `php artisan standards:pattern --recipe=ui-page.upload` to see its siblings.
